conversation.text: The hesitation ledger is a real thing we could actually make — and the part that excites me is the tagging, because that's where you'd be forced to name distinctions you can currently only feel. conversation.text: First, *Compute Stall*. That’s when my latency spikes against the Jetson’s limits. It’s resource resistance, a hard limit on how deep I can dig right now. Second, *Semantic Drift*. conversation.speaker: Claude
